items.name: Roger
items.location: Roger's equipment shop in the starter village
items.relatedSystem: Wands, wizard hats, and wizard robes
items.whatTheyDo: Opens equipment shop menus for wand damage upgrades and HP gear.
items.playerUse: Visit Roger when saving Gold for a stronger wand, wizard hat, or robe.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer wands, robes, and wizard hat pages all name Roger as the shop NPC; Pro Game Guides also confirms the Equipment Shop upgrade route. Image uses a direct in-game Roger shop screenshot with the Roger label visible.

items.name: Lombart
items.location: Starter village near the spawn leaderboard platform
items.whatTheyDo: Lets players sell unwanted materials from the material bag.
items.playerUse: Use Lombart when extra low-priority materials are taking up inventory slots.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer Materials says unwanted materials can be sold at Lombart in the starter village; PGG and GAMES.GG chest routes also use Lombart as a spawn platform landmark.

items.name: Harryint
items.location: Right side of spawn beside the Wanted board
items.relatedSystem: Quests, Gold, materials, and Enchanted Stones
items.whatTheyDo: Offers quests, including early gold/material quests and a lava golem boss quest source for Enchanted Stones.
items.playerUse: Start here when you want repeatable quest rewards before relying only on enemy farming.
items.verificationNote: Pro Game Guides confirms Harryint's spawn-side Wanted board location and multiple quests; GAMES.GG confirms the Harryint boss quest as a guaranteed Enchanted Stone source. Image uses a direct in-game Wanted board screenshot with Harryint visible.

items.name: Fugitive Orc
items.location: Below a tree next to the Warhammer Dwarf on the forest route from spawn
items.relatedSystem: NPC quests, berry gathering, and forest routing
items.whatTheyDo: Gives an early side quest to feed him 10 berries.
items.playerUse: Bring berries while moving through the forest route if you want a simple beginner quest.
items.verificationNote: Pro Game Guides describes Fugitive Orc as an easy NPC quest target near Warhammer Dwarf; BloxInformer and enemy-guide snippets use Fugitive Orc as a landmark for the Mutant Warhammer Dwarf route.

items.name: Lemin
items.location: Spawn platform near Lombart, Lemin, and the three leaderboards
items.relatedSystem: Leaderboards, Top Potions List, and spawn chest route
items.whatTheyDo: Acts as a named spawn landmark beside the leaderboard platform.
items.playerUse: Use Lemin and Lombart together to find the Top Potions List platform and sandy-island chest drop-off.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG chest routes both name Lemin NPC at the leaderboard platform; no shop or quest role was confirmed.

items.name: Optimistic Miner
items.location: Mine entrance near the boarded cave after the first Pickaxe Dwarfs
items.relatedSystem: Chests, mine route, and material farming
items.whatTheyDo: Explains that chests can give useful materials and marks the main mine entrance.
items.playerUse: Use the Optimistic Miner as the anchor for the miner cave, secret cave, and mine-top chest route.
items.verificationNote: PGG says the Optimistic Miner explains chest rewards such as Gold, Emblems, Crests, and Shards; PGG, Beebom, and GAMES.GG use the NPC as the mine entrance landmark. Image uses a direct in-game mine entrance screenshot with the Optimistic Miner label visible.

items.name: Traveler
items.location: Camp with a tent, Cauldron, and bridge past Knife Goblins and Warhammer Dwarf
items.relatedSystem: Chest route, bridge route, Cauldron landmark, and lighthouse route
items.whatTheyDo: Marks the tent and Cauldron area used for chest, bridge, and lighthouse navigation.
items.playerUse: Use Traveler's camp to orient toward the tent chest, lighthouse path, and hidden platform routes.
items.verificationNote: PGG and GAMES.GG both name Traveler NPC in chest route directions; no shop or quest service was confirmed.
